_help: Hunter's Path (personal tracks). templates = the gate board; every field can be changed in the builder. kind: daily | abstain | target | milestone. days: gate length (null = no end). schedule: Mon..Sun (daily). amount/unit: per day (daily) or per period (target). period: week | total. stat: body | mind | discipline | health. title: Hunter's Path

templates.title: 30 days without porn
templates.why: Why do you want this? Write it for the moment an urge hits.
templates.blurb: Check in each evening. The SOS button helps when an urge hits.

templates.title: 1 book a week for a month
templates.blurb: Log a book when you finish it. One per week, four weeks.

templates.title: Meditate 10 minutes a day
templates.blurb: Ten minutes of quiet, every day for a month.

templates.title: Gym 3 times a week
templates.blurb: Log each workout. Three a week for eight weeks.

templates.title: 10,000 steps a day
templates.blurb: Enter your steps from your phone's step counter.

templates.title: No sugar for 21 days
templates.blurb: No sweets, soft drinks or desserts. Fruit is fine.

templates.title: No social media after 22:00
templates.blurb: Check in each night: did you stay off after 22:00?

templates.title: Wake up at 6:00
templates.blurb: Tick it when you're up by 6:00.

templates.title: Journal every day
templates.blurb: A few lines every day: what happened, what you learned.

templates.title: Cold shower
templates.blurb: End every shower with 30 seconds of cold water.

templates.title: In bed by 23:00
templates.blurb: Tick it when you're in bed by 23:00.

templates.title: Reach my LevelUp daily goal

templates.title: Run a 10K
